seo.title: The Gift of Time Offline | Drift & Dwells Gift Vouchers
seo.description: Give someone a few days away from noise, screens, and schedules. A Drift & Dwells gift voucher, delivered by email or as a physical card by post.

hero.title: The Gift of Time Offline
hero.lead: Give someone a few days away from noise, screens, and schedules.
hero.textBefore: A Drift & Dwells gift voucher, delivered by email or as a physical card by post — prepaid credit toward a future stay at
hero.tail: It is not a discount. It is a quiet invitation, redeemable when the moment is right.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.line1: You choose an amount. We send your gift by email or prepare a physical card by post.
howItWorks.line2: They redeem it during booking when they decide where and when to slow down.
howItWorks.line3: Vouchers are valid for twelve months and can be applied to any available night at The Cabin or The Valley. The remaining balance stays on the voucher for future stays until it is fully used or expires.
